ScalarMath.Help.Modulo: Remainder after division; the result has the dividend's sign. A zero divisor fails.
ScalarMath.Help.Fraction: Value minus floor(Value); for example, -1.25 becomes 0.75.
ScalarMath.Help.Ceil: Round toward positive infinity to an integer.
ScalarMath.Help.Smoothstep: Smoothly transition from 0 at Low to 1 at High; Low must be less than High.
ScalarMath.Help.InverseLerp: Return (Value - Start) / (End - Start), without clamping; equal endpoints fail.
ScalarMath.Help.Saturate: Clamp Value to the range 0 to 1.
ScalarMath.Help.Step: Return 0 below Edge and 1 at or above Edge.
ScalarMath.Help.Truncate: Round toward zero to an integer.
